title: A modern day recipe binder
body: I learned how to cook the old-school way, out of my Nonna’s recipe book. You know the one. Handwritten recipes, random notes in the margins, a few mystery stains, and measurements like “a little bit of this” and “enough of that.” Somehow, it always worked. Inspo is basically the modern-day version of Nonna’s recipe binder, and I absolutely love it. For years, my brilliant recipe-saving system consisted of sending cooking videos to myself in Messenger, only to go looking for one six months later and discover the creator had taken it down. Recipe gone. Dinner plans destroyed. Not anymore. Everything is right at my fingertips. I can save recipes, organize them, build my shopping list, and actually find the recipe again when I want to make it. Imagine that! The app is incredibly easy and intuitive to use. And when you serve something that has everyone asking, “Can you send me that recipe?” you can share the individual recipe with them instead of explaining where you found some random video eight months ago. Nonna had the recipe book. I have Inspo. Same concept, fewer mystery stains. Absolutely five stars. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
